stages.validation_method: Walkthrough with process owners and affected users.
stages.purpose: translate business needs into process and decision requirements
execution_instructions: Map current actors, events, inputs, decisions, exceptions and downstream outcomes.
Identify process pain points, business rules, data ownership and control points.
Model the proposed state and compare impacts, dependencies and exception paths.
Trace each requirement to a business objective and a measurable acceptance condition.
quality_criteria: Process paths include normal, exception and failure cases.
Rules have an owner and source.
Requirements are testable and trace to a business outcome.

stages.approval_rationale: Commits budget and staff to the project on the organization's behalf; only the sponsor may authorize that.
Accepting contract terms creates legal obligations; the legal owner must approve before commitment.

stages.validation_method: Product/design review and quick usability walkthrough.
stages.purpose: explore information hierarchy and interaction structure before visual polish
execution_instructions: Identify primary tasks and content hierarchy for each screen.
Create low-fidelity layouts with navigation, states, responsive behavior and annotations.
Review task completion paths, empty/error/loading states and keyboard flow.
Record design decisions and unresolved usability questions.
quality_criteria: Wireframes cover all critical states and target viewports.
Labels and navigation support user goals.
No decorative styling hides missing behavior.

stages.purpose: prove requirements are complete, consistent, feasible and testable
execution_instructions: Check each requirement for atomicity, necessity, clarity, feasibility and verifiability.
Trace business goals to requirements, design elements and test cases.
Run ambiguity, conflict, duplication and orphan checks.
Resolve or explicitly defer findings with owners before baseline approval.
quality_criteria: No critical orphan, conflict or untestable requirement remains.
Stakeholders approve the baseline version.
Deferred items have owner and impact.

stages.validation_method: Architecture review against documented quality attribute scenarios.
stages.purpose: define the system structure and component boundaries for the target quality attributes
execution_instructions: Define system context, actors, external systems and trust boundaries.
Decompose capabilities into components and assign ownership, interfaces and dependency direction.
Evaluate synchronous/asynchronous boundaries, data ownership, failure isolation and deployment topology.
Compare architecture options against latency, availability, scalability, security, operability and cost scenarios.
quality_criteria: Every component has responsibility and owner.
Dependencies and failure domains are explicit.
Trade-offs are tied to measurable quality scenarios.

stages.validation_method: Cloud security and operations design review.
stages.purpose: design a secure, resilient and supportable cloud landing pattern
execution_instructions: Choose regions, network zones, identity boundaries and managed services against requirements.
Model failure domains, autoscaling, backup, observability and deployment topology.
Define policy-as-code, encryption, key ownership and secret integration.
Estimate lifecycle cost and document portability/vendor lock-in trade-offs.
quality_criteria: Failure domains align with RTO/RPO.
IAM and network boundaries are least privilege.
Cost assumptions and service quotas are explicit.

stages.purpose: design reliable boundaries between independently operated systems
execution_instructions: Select synchronous or asynchronous interaction based on coupling and latency needs.
Define schema, correlation IDs, idempotency, retries, ordering and dead-letter behavior.
Specify authentication, secrets, rate limits, observability and contract evolution.
Test timeout, duplicate, partial failure and partner outage scenarios.
quality_criteria: Every interface has owner and version policy.
Retries cannot create unsafe duplicate side effects.
Failure handling and telemetry are specified.

stages.purpose: publish architecture decisions and models for future operators
execution_instructions: Document context, scope, constraints, component boundaries and data/control flows.
Link ADRs, interfaces, deployment topology, quality attributes and known limitations.
Keep diagrams source-controlled and validate rendering and links.
Assign owners and review triggers for decisions that can become stale.
quality_criteria: Documentation matches deployed reality.
Every key decision has rationale and alternatives.
Owners and freshness triggers are defined.

stages.purpose: decompose approved scope into estimable and verifiable work
execution_instructions: Decompose deliverables into work packages with clear boundaries and owners.
Identify dependencies, integration points, external approvals and critical path.
Define acceptance evidence and estimate-ready assumptions for each package.
Review decomposition with delivery and technical owners before estimating.
quality_criteria: Every scope item maps to a work package.
No package is too broad to estimate or verify.
Dependencies and ownership are explicit.

stages.purpose: align decision-makers and affected parties through the lifecycle
execution_instructions: Identify decision authority, affected users, veto points and information needs.
Set communication cadence and channel by stakeholder group.
Capture decisions, concerns, commitments and unresolved conflicts.
Escalate missing decisions before they block downstream work.
quality_criteria: Every key decision has an owner and due date.
Affected parties are informed before impact.
Conflicts are resolved or explicitly escalated.

stages.approval_rationale: Approving a change request alters committed scope, cost or schedule; the change board decides, not the requester.

stages.purpose: establish a secure and reproducible engineering workspace
execution_instructions: Inspect repository state, ownership, package manifests, existing CI and local instructions before changes.
Define branch protection, review ownership, required checks, reproducible setup and supported toolchain.
Keep credentials out of source; use approved secret storage and least-privilege access.
Add onboarding and contribution guidance, then validate from a clean checkout.
quality_criteria: A clean contributor can reproduce setup.
Protected branches require review and checks.
No secret value is committed.

stages.approval_rationale: Rotating or revoking production secrets can cause outages and is hard to undo; a human must confirm timing and blast radius.
stages.approval_condition: when rotating or revoking production secrets

stages.validation_method: Peer review by product, engineering and QA.
stages.purpose: create a navigable, versioned and traceable specification
execution_instructions: Organize scope, actors, terminology, requirements, constraints, dependencies and exclusions.
Assign stable IDs and link each requirement to source, owner and downstream tests.
Document diagrams, examples, exceptions and unresolved decisions in the repository convention.
Review clarity, consistency, links, version and change history.
quality_criteria: No ambiguous pronouns or unbounded terms remain in normative requirements.
IDs are stable and traceable.
Links, diagrams and examples render.

inputs: API contracts and browser support matrix
stages.validation_method: UI peer review and browser test run.
stages.purpose: implement accessible client behavior and resilient interface states
execution_instructions: Inspect routing, state management, component conventions and existing design system.
Implement semantic components, responsive layout, keyboard behavior and loading/empty/error states.
Integrate typed or validated API boundaries and handle cancellation/retry safely.
Add component and browser tests for critical interactions; verify accessibility and console/network errors.
quality_criteria: Critical flows work at supported viewports.
Keyboard and screen-reader semantics are preserved.
No unhandled errors or leaked async state.

stages.approval_rationale: Merging changes the protected branch that feeds releases; branch protection must record a human code-owner approval, not the agent's own.

stages.category_name: Code Review, Static Analysis and Quality Engineering

stages.approval_rationale: UAT acceptance means the business accepts the release; the product owner, not the QA agent that ran the tests, must accept.
Active testing against a target without written authorization may be illegal or disruptive; a human owner must approve scope, target and window first.
Accepting a license exception creates a legal obligation for the organization; only a legal or compliance owner may accept it.
stages.approval_condition: when a license exception is requested

stages.approval_rationale: Accepting residual security risk or releasing with open findings is a risk decision that must not be made by the agent that fixed or scanned the code.
Applying IaC that deletes resources or changes IAM can destroy data or widen access; a human owner must review the plan output before apply.
stages.approval_condition: before applying a plan to production; always when the plan destroys resources or changes IAM

stages.approval_rationale: Firewall, security-group and routing changes can expose services or cut connectivity; an infrastructure owner must approve production changes.
stages.approval_condition: for production firewall, security-group or routing changes

stages.approval_rationale: Authorizes a production change; segregation of duties requires someone other than the requester to approve.
Production schema or data changes can be irreversible and cause data loss; a DBA owner must confirm backup, dry run and rollback.
Changes customer-facing systems; an authorized human must approve the exact artifact version and window.
Failover or restore actions can cause downtime or data loss and are a business decision; the DR owner must authorize execution.
Resizing, deleting or committing spend on billing-sensitive resources has direct financial impact; a FinOps owner must approve changes.
stages.approval_condition: when resizing, deleting or committing spend on billing-sensitive resources
